categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and clinical application of orthopedic surgical robots and related technologies. Its main products include orthopedic surgical navigation positioning robots, supporting equipment and consumables, and technical services. The company also provides intelligent orthopedic surgical platforms and aims to become a foundational infrastructure in the orthopedic industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as high-precision online calibration, multi-modal medical image fusion and processing, AI-based medical image processing and automatic surgical planning, active and passive optical tracking, modular design of surgical tools, and self-balancing robot support technology. Its production method involves autonomous design, global procurement of components, customized processing of core precision parts, software embedding, and final assembly and debugging. The company also has in-house manufacturing capabilities for end surgical tools and disposable surgical toolkits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are medical institutions, including hospitals and surgical centers. The company serves the orthopedic surgery market, focusing on spine surgery, trauma surgery, joint replacement surgery, and related sub-specialties. It targets domestic Chinese hospitals and is expanding internationally, with CE certification enabling entry into European markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with sales and clinical applications in over 200 medical institutions nationwide. It is actively pursuing international expansion, having obtained CE certification for its products to enter European markets. Key domestic regions include North China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Northeast China, Central China, and Northwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and develops orthopedic surgical robots and related consumables, procures components globally, assembles and tests products, and sells directly or through distributors to medical institutions. It also provides ongoing technical services and clinical support, integrating product sales with service offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on continuous innovation in orthopedic surgical robot technology, expanding product indications, and enriching its product portfolio. It emphasizes the 'industry-academia-research-medical' collaborative innovation model, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on AI, multi-modal imaging, and intelligent surgical planning. The company aims to enhance international certification, develop new surgical tools, and promote intelligent, personalized, and remote surgical solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of orthopedic surgical robots, supporting equipment, and consumables. Additionally, the company earns income from technical services, including providing clinical technology support and 'purchase of technical services' models where medical institutions pay for ongoing surgical technology services. This diversified revenue model combines one-time equipment sales with recurring consumable sales and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's orthopedic surgical robot industry, holding the largest market share domestically despite increasing competition. Major international competitors include Johnson & Johnson, Stryker, Zimmer Biomet, Medtronic, and Smith & Nephew. Domestic competitors include Tuoda, Jianjia, Huaruibo, Zhuzheng, MicroPort, Gushengyuanhua, and Xinjunte. The company leverages its first-mover advantage, extensive clinical adoption, and strong R&D capabilities to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 178.8 million, a 14.85% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 121.1 million, though the loss narrowed compared to prior years. R&D investment accounted for 65.34% of revenue. The company has not yet achieved profitability but has improved operational efficiency and cash flow. Total assets reached RMB 1.69 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.27 billion at year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its orthopedic surgical robots' clinical advantages of precision, minimally invasive operation, intelligence, and low radiation. It offers a comprehensive intelligent surgical platform integrating hardware and software, supported by a strong clinical service system. Its products cover a wide range of orthopedic indications with modular design enabling multi-use, supported by extensive patents and proprietary technologies. The company aims to improve surgical outcomes, reduce learning curves for surgeons, and enhance patient quality of life.
